gloss: to hit the mark; to strike the target

definitions.gloss: to hit the mark; to strike the target; to hit
definitions.explanation: For a projectile, shot, or thrown object to reach and hit its intended target. Used for physical targets such as in shooting, archery, or combat.

definitions.gloss: to guess correctly; to hit the nail on the head
definitions.explanation: For a prediction, guess, or assessment to turn out to be exactly right. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: {弾|たま}が{的|まと}に{命中|めいちゅう}した。
{矢|や}が{三本|さんぼん}とも{命中|めいちゅう}した。
examples.english: All three arrows hit the mark.

examples.japanese: ミサイルは{目標|もくひょう}に{正確|せいかく}に{命中|めいちゅう}した。
examples.english: The missile struck the target precisely.

examples.japanese: {予想|よそう}が{命中|めいちゅう}した。
examples.english: My prediction was right on the mark.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{指摘|してき}は{核心|かくしん}を{命中|めいちゅう}していた。
examples.english: Her observation hit right at the heart of the matter.

examples.japanese: {天気予報|てんきよほう}が{見事|みごと}に{命中|めいちゅう}して、{午後|ごご}から{本当|ほんとう}に{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The weather forecast was spot on, and it really did start raining in the afternoon.

notes:
Composed of {命|めい} (life, fate, order) and {中|ちゅう} (hit, middle). Originally a military and martial arts term that has extended into everyday figurative use. The {命中|めいちゅう}{率|りつ} (hit rate, accuracy rate) is commonly used in gaming and statistics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {的|まと}に{命中|めいちゅう}する: to hit the target
- {命中|めいちゅう}{率|りつ}: hit rate, accuracy
- {予想|よそう}が{命中|めいちゅう}する: a prediction proves correct
- {正確|せいかく}に{命中|めいちゅう}する: to hit accurately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当|あ}たる: to hit — everyday word; broader in meaning (lottery, guess, etc.)
- {的中|てきちゅう}する: to hit the mark — very similar; more commonly used for predictions and guesses
- {当|あ}てる: to hit (transitive) — casual; to aim and successfully hit something
